label: Tenochtitlan, 1519
_note: Massing proxies for the video model, not an archaeological reconstruction. Offsets are meters from the Templo Mayor anchor (x east, y north). Every element lists its sources and a confidence. Positions marked 'illustrative' are the author's layout choices within what the sources say; review them in docs/era_1519_review.md.

remove.note: No standing modern building existed in 1519; the colonial city was built over the Aztec one.

water.note: Lake Texcoco as a flat water plane at 6 m above today's Zócalo ground: today's DEM floods the old lake bed (incl. Tepetzinco / Peñón de los Baños as an island). Subsidence since 1519 is not modeled.

island.note: Tenochtitlan and Tlatelolco, about 12 km² (D1: 8-13.5 km²). West edge near today's Av. Bucareli (D1). Exact shoreline undocumented.

canals.note: Dense canal network between districts (C1, D1); routes unknown, so a regular grid. Chinampa gardens near the shore.

houses.note: Commoners: one-storey reed, mud or adobe with flat or thatched roofs; elite: plastered stone around a court (D1, C1).

precinct.note: Walled quadrangle (coatepantli) about 440 x 400 m (D2). Placement: Templo Mayor on the east side facing west, Temple of the Sun under today's Catedral (D1).

plazas.name: Plaza south of the precinct (today's Zócalo)

structures.name: Templo Mayor
structures.note: Phase VII: base about 100 x 80 m, pyramid about 30 m, 45-60 m with shrines (D2). Tlaloc north, Huitzilopochtli south; stairs west.

structures.name: Temple of Ehecatl-Quetzalcoatl
structures.note: Round temple on the axis in front of the Templo Mayor (D1).

structures.name: Ballcourt
structures.note: East-west court west of the Templo Mayor (D1).

structures.name: Tzompantli
structures.note: Skull-rack platform beside the ballcourt (D1). Massing only.

structures.name: Temple of Tezcatlipoca
structures.note: One of about 45 precinct buildings (D1); position and size assumed.

structures.name: Northern temple
structures.note: Generic precinct temple; position and size assumed.

structures.name: Calmecac
structures.note: Priests' school in the precinct (D1); position assumed.

structures.name: Palace of Moctezuma II
structures.note: On the site of today's Palacio Nacional (D1); described by Cortés (C1). Size from the modern block.

structures.name: Palace of Axayacatl
structures.note: West of the precinct, near today's Monte de Piedad (D1); Spanish quarters in 1519 (C2).

causeways.name: Tlacopan causeway (west)
causeways.note: Route along today's Calle Tacuba, Av. Hidalgo, Puente de Alvarado and Calzada México-Tacuba: a common claim, not yet sourced. Width: 'ten horses abreast' (C2). Removable bridges (C1).

causeways.name: Iztapalapa causeway (south)
causeways.note: Route along today's Pino Suárez and Calzada de Tlalpan (assumed).
